stations.name: Earth Station Prime
stations.description: The principal orbital installation above Earth. Houses the primary offices of the Interstellar Settlement Authority and the major regulatory institutions governing colonization, commerce, and security across the Sol system. All new corporations registered under the ISP framework maintain a mandatory operational presence here.

stations.name: Luna Gateway
stations.description: A compact orbital hub anchored above Luna's near side. Originally constructed as a waypoint for deep-space freight operations, it has since become a secondary administrative centre for Sol-based corporations seeking lower overhead and proximity to Helium-3 extraction zones.

stations.name: Mars Orbital Dock
stations.description: The primary docking facility in Mars orbit. Serves as the logistical backbone for all silicate mining operations on the Martian surface and a growing hub for refinery infrastructure. The ISA maintains a Claims & Leases office here for expedited lease processing.

stations.name: Centauri Prime Orbital
stations.description: The first permanent orbital installation in the Alpha Centauri system. Administered jointly by the ISA and the Centauri Colonial Authority, it serves as the primary trade and administrative hub for all corporate operations beyond Sol. Lease processing, exchange access, and frontier logistics are all available.

stations.name: Ironwell Mining Depot
stations.description: A rugged frontier depot in orbit above Ironwell, the mineral-rich inner world of Barnard's Star. Built to service the heavy extraction industry that defines the system, it operates under a low-regulation charter that attracts independent mining corporations.

stations.name: Halo Anchorage
stations.description: A fortified orbital anchorage above Halo in the contested Wolf 359 system. Serves as a neutral staging point for corporate and military operations in the region. ISA arbitration services and exchange access are maintained despite the system's volatile security profile.

stations.name: Verde Trade Hub
stations.description: The commercial heart of the Tau Ceti system, positioned in orbit above the temperate world of Verde. A treaty-governed station operating under strict tariff controls, it functions as the primary trade corridor between the inner colonies and the frontier systems.

stations.name: Kestrel Platform
stations.description: A semi-private orbital platform licensed by the Eridani Station Authority above the resource-rich world of Kestrel. Corporate tenants enjoy reduced regulatory overhead in exchange for annual licensing fees. Exchange and lease services are available.

stations.name: Lalande Registry Station
stations.description: The Bureau's second registry, in orbit over Lalande 21185 b. It files claims on Sol's terms and keeps the survey protectorate's records; a neutral port, open to every corporation to dock, rent an office and trade.

stations.name: Compact Hall
stations.description: The meeting hall and dock of the Sagittarius Mining Compact, above Ross 154 I. Claims are voted one lease to one vote, but the dock and its offices are neutral: any corporation may berth and rent space here.

stations.name: Sirius Exchange Anchorage
stations.description: The Sirius Exchange Authority's trading port on the moon Canis Anchorage: brokers, not miners, and the busiest exchange floor off Sol. A neutral charter port, open to every corporation to dock, rent an office and trade.

stations.name: Frost Relay Depot
stations.description: The ISA Northern Survey's relay post on the ice moon Rime: a depot more than a port, lightly held. Neutral, open to every corporation to dock and rent an office.

stations.name: Twin Flare Outpost
stations.description: An armoured outpost over BL Ceti I, between the twin flare stars. No authority holds the system's claims, but the outpost itself is neutral ground: any corporation may dock and rent an office here.

stations.name: Southern Reef Platform
stations.description: The Southern Arm Consortium's platform above Lacaille 9352 c. The consortium's lease pool is for members only; the platform's dock and offices are neutral and open to every corporation.

stations.name: Procyon Free Port
stations.description: The Free Port's charter station on the moon Canis Minor Port: tariff-free trade under a single charter. Neutral, open to every corporation to dock and rent an office.

stations.name: Quiet Star Station
stations.description: The Quiet Star Trust's station over Ross 128 b, a research reserve's one door, which leases sparingly. Neutral, open to every corporation to dock and rent an office.

stations.name: Cygni Condominium
stations.description: The shared station over 61 Cygni A I, run by the two rival charters that hold the twin stars together. Neutral, open to every corporation to dock and rent an office.

stations.name: Kapteyn Salvage Court
stations.description: A salvage court over Kapteyn b, where no authority rules and salvage law is the only law. Neutral, open to every corporation to dock and rent an office.

stations.name: Indi Convoy Station
stations.description: The convoy captains' station over Epsilon Indi Ab, where the brown-dwarf frontier's survey claims are arbitrated. Neutral, open to every corporation to dock and rent an office.

stations.name: Cassiopeia Reach Post
stations.description: The Cassiopeia Reach post over Kruger 60 I, whose register records claims by whichever convoy arrived first. Neutral, open to every corporation to dock and rent an office.

stations.name: Ophiuchus Frontier Office
stations.description: The ISA's outpost over Wolf 1061 c, at the edge of its writ. Neutral, open to every corporation to dock and rent an office.

stations.name: Altair Compact Exchange
stations.description: The Altair Compact's station over Altair I: the frontier's own exchange. Neutral, open to every corporation to dock and rent an office.

stations.name: Serpent Accord Station
stations.description: The Serpent Accord's station over 70 Ophiuchi A I, where two stars' claims are held in trust by rival consortia. Neutral, open to every corporation to dock and rent an office.

stations.name: Remnant Beacon
stations.description: A beacon station over Cinder Remnant, in a dead system's debris that no one claims. Neutral, open to every corporation to dock and rent an office.
